name: Rizuhble's Bob Ross Has A Glock
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Living Ink T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Mystic Burst, weapon 4.8k at Recharging Rush. Ultimate (Abstract Landscape) is available from Surge of Power.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 14 to Still Life's damage (1.40x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Recharging Rush, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.why: weapon investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Recharging Rush, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and weapon is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Living Ink (2 to 3).

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Living Ink: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +19.6 on its damage (0.70x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (4,000 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Flow State (203), Still Life (140) clear its 80-damage trigger.

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Recharging Rush completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Recharging Rush completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-16,000 (levels 16-22). Your biggest single spirit hit (Flow State, max damage) grows from 223 to 304. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Spirit Lifesteal, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Healbane
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Spirit Lifesteal completes 1,600 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Spirit Lifesteal completes 4.8k vitality in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 20 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 32.4 to Flow State's max damage (1.80x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 16,000-43,200 (levels 22-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Flow State T3, Still Life T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Flow State, max damage) grows from 304 to 515.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Living Ink: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 45 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Living Ink (3 to 4). Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 54 to Flow State's max damage (1.80x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 15,200 to 20,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Flow State (454), Still Life (335) clear its 165-damage trigger. Takes spirit from 20,000 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 22,400 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Infuser? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
sections.desc: Dying after Infuser? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Spirit damage that keeps hurting you after the hit: Infernus, Seven, Vyper, Lady Geist.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: Lash ult, Infernus ult. Anything big you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex and slows.

items.name: Knockdown
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Flyers like Vindicta and Grey Talon keep getting away.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.caption: Silences, disarms and blocks item use on one enemy for 3.25s and strips their non-ultimate buffs, at -25% damage for you and a 55s cooldown: a single-target answer to a buffed carry or engage.
items.legacy_note: Shut their carry down before a fight.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Spellslinger
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: You cast so often that it stays at full stacks. Sell Mystic Shot for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 9,600 to 14,400 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 204s of base cooldown across your kit, 145s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.
